name: RetailCo Black Friday 2026 Readiness
description: Authoritative machine-readable M1 reference scenario evaluating peak transactional capacity, checkout latency limits, and architectural headroom for Black Friday 2026.

formalResolutionEvent.resolutionRationale: Formally approved commercial demand projection from Black Friday 2026 Business Forecast (BF26-Commercial-Demand-Model.xlsx) as authoritative baseline for peak capacity sizing.

checkoutResponseTime.ambiguityReason: Response-time percentile is not defined (e.g. median, p90, p95, p99, or maximum).

throughputConversions.semanticConstraint: Unit conversion of transaction/order volume only. This value must NOT be described as user/session arrival rate unless source intelligence explicitly defines that relationship.

concurrencyCalculation.reason: Average session duration is known, but session arrival rate is not. Peak order throughput cannot be assumed to equal session arrival rate.
requiredIntelligence: Peak session starts/hour OR an approved relationship that converts business orders into session arrivals.
concurrencyCalculation.forbiddenBehavior: Engine must NOT multiply peak orders/second (8.75) by session duration (480s) to synthesize 4,200 concurrent sessions without proof that every session yields exactly one order.

historicalPreResolutionState.description: State of intelligence prior to formal resolution event where peak orders was conflicting across three sources.

conflictingItem.reason: Three competing values (18,000, 24,000, 31,500) found across upstream project artefacts.

remainingBlockers.reason: Target specifies < 2.0s without an associated percentile (e.g. p95 or p99). Required for automated gate evaluation.
